meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你排查容器化 agent 的问题：查看主机与容器日志、检查会话数据库（inbound.db / outbound.db）里的消息流、挂载与心跳文件，并说明常见故障的原因和对应修复命令。
howto.when: 当容器起不来、agent 没有回复、出现认证（如 401）问题，或想弄清容器系统怎么运作时触发。

say.text: 容器起不来，agent 没回复，帮我查一下原因
say.note: 它会去看日志和会话 DB 的消息流

say.text: 日志里报 No adapter for channel type，怎么修
say.note: 它会指出重复的服务实例并给出停止命令

howto.what_en: After install, Claude helps debug containerized agent issues: reading host and container logs, checking the session DBs (inbound.db/outbound.db) message flow, mounts and heartbeat files, and explaining causes and fixes for common failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a container fails, the agent stops replying, authentication (e.g. 401) problems appear, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container won't start and the agent isn't replying — find out why
say_en.note: Reads logs and the session DB message flow

say_en.text: Check whether this session's inbound.db and outbound.db have messages
The log says No adapter for channel type — how do I fix it
say_en.note: Points to duplicate service instances and stop commands
